transcript: My name is Esmi Silva. I am an IT intern preparing for a mobile app developer role. I practiced Flutter, Firebase, and REST API. I worked on a bus tracking mobile app for transport. My part was out tracking. The issue was GPS delay. The system improved tracking accuracy. I want to improve my skills.
feedback: Esmi, you provided a clear overview of your experience, but your answer could be more structured. For example, you could have explained how you overcame the GPS delay issue in more detail.
strengths: Good experience with Flutter, Firebase, and REST API
Ability to work on a real-world project
weaknesses: Lack of clarity in explaining the project's impact
Insufficient detail on how you overcame the GPS delay issue
suggestions: Provide specific examples to support your claims
Explain how your skills align with the mobile app developer role
better_answer_example: Here's an example of a better answer: 'In my previous internship, I worked on a bus tracking mobile app using Flutter and Firebase. I was responsible for the out-tracking feature, which faced a GPS delay issue. To overcome this, I implemented a data buffering system that improved the tracking accuracy by 30%. This experience has taught me the importance of data handling in mobile app development, and I'm excited to apply this knowledge in a mobile app developer role.'
